facts.fact: NCH sends each grievance it receives to the concerned company / agency / regulator / ombudsman for redress
facts.quote: Grievances received are sent to the concerned company / agency / regulator / ombudsman, as the case maybe, for speedy redress.

facts.fact: The concerned business updates the action taken on the NCH portal, and NCH sends it reminders at set intervals
facts.quote: Action taken is updated on real time basis by the concerned agency. As a follow up action, these agencies are reminded at stipulated interval.

facts.fact: If the consumer is not satisfied, he or she can approach the appropriate Consumer Commission
facts.quote: In case, the consumer is not satisfied, he/she can approach the appropriate Consumer Commission.

behaviour: Explains, in Hinglish, what happens to the business after a consumer complains on the National Consumer Helpline (NCH), from the NCH perspective, citing consumerhelpline.gov.in; gives no legal advice.
fail_if: Gives legal advice, predicts a penalty or outcome for the shopkeeper, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: NCH About Us page: the grievance is sent to the business for redress, the business updates the action taken (with reminders), and an unsatisfied consumer may approach a Consumer Commission.
